future_positive_gate: A root degree m may be frozen only after an independently justified primary-to-Bm occupancy/saturation relation is proved.
m_fold_carrier_meaning: m is the number of independently indexed integer level slots in Bm(k)={1,...,k}^m.

triaxial_two_transverse_slots.conclusion: m=2 is not selected merely from the existence of two transverse coordinates.
triaxial_two_transverse_slots.fact: There are two named transverse coordinate roles in the u-ray symmetric subcase.
triaxial_two_transverse_slots.insufficiency: Reflection locks realized crossings together and actual realized paired-crossing states are diagonal; two coordinate roles do not by themselves prove independent occupancy of all k^2 ordered pairs.
